list_issue_discussions.description: List discussions for an issue. Use this to inspect threaded discussions for an issue; use `list_issues` for issue records and `get_issue` for one issue's fields. It is read-only and returns discussion items, while invalid identifiers, missing issues, and permission failures are reported as errors.

issue_iid.description: The internal ID of the project issue

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max: 100, default: 20)
